description: Spends the account's AI credits: ask the user before calling, then pass confirm: true. Start an AI Lab assistant chat with a question (research only: it finds traders, saves, backtests and paper-trades strategies in YOUR account, never places orders). Spends your plan's AI credits (a question needs 25 to start; a typical one costs about 13; `deep: true` runs the slower, more thorough mode, about twice the credits, Lab Pro and up). Your plan answers a number of chats at once (Pro Trader 2 … Enterprise 8; one more is refused 429 lab_agent_busy). Waits up to `wait_seconds` (default 45, max 55) for the answer; if it is still working, poll polyrank_lab_get_chat with the returned id. A long backtest it starts answers at once and its result is posted to the chat later. Results are SIMULATED. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY.

confirm.description: Required: true, and only after the user agreed to this call in the conversation.

name: polyrank_lab_ask
title: Polyrank AI Lab assistant: ask in a new chat
